comment.body:
#codex-reply
Fixed in 973f610b0778adf2b3e8814090cc53aa62d4201c

PublisherManager.stopPublishers() now force-terminates the phaser during terminal shutdown, which wakes phase-0 and phase-1 waiters. initializePublishers() and startPublishers() both exit when the phaser reports termination, and startPublishers() no longer creates a startup executor after the manager is already stopped.

Self-review: this keeps the previous fixes intact. Stopped managers cannot reopen the start gate, late initialize still stops only after publisher.start() returns, pre-start publishers are not stopped from teardown, and startup waiters now wake instead of leaking when permissions or initialization never complete.
